seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Ring/beam/blocks crane: A1/A2 move ring+beam y-/+6, carrying blocks on the beam; push_chain pushes any blocks that are hit, and the whole move is cancelled if a block goes past y<2.
A4/A3 change beam w by +/-6 (w from 1 to 43). An unhooked extend pushes the blocks it sweeps; if the chain would go past x>48, the beam slides through alone.
Hooked = a next/collected block at x==beam.x+w-5. It drags every block on the beam; if any would hit x>48 or the ring, the beam moves alone.
Tags: a next block that is hooked and alone on the beam -> collected, and the rightmost todo -> next; an unhooked collected block reverts to next. Clicks are no-ops.
Unconfirmed: lower bound (y<=58) and ring bounds; ordering when more than one block is collected. Passes stateless, with no hidden state.
